name: codegraph-query
description: Read-only query workflow for CodeGraph SQLite indexes under .codegraph/codegraph.db, used for code location, caller/callee checks, route lookup, and first-pass impact analysis.
defaultPrompt: Query CodeGraph to locate a frontend function
Analyze the impact of changing an indexed frontend file
Find the indexed route or entry related to an API path
Show callers and callees for an indexed function
